name: Projects: propose a file
objective: A new or changed file for a project, whole. Unless this assistant may write it directly, it is kept as a proposal the project's owner accepts or declines; the file stays as it was until then.

project.label: Project
project.hint: its short name (slug), as project_list gives it

text.label: The whole new text of the file

why.label: Why
why.hint: one or two sentences the owner reads before deciding
